answer: Audits are entered in vault, queued in lagoon, and falcon publishes the wait time. A farm of 86 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 93 identities per epoch. A farm of 1518 identities would post 2480 proofs and burn roughly 87 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
